blocs.title: Prompt foundations & strategic copy
blocs.subtitle: From Google query to agency brief

sections.title: Philosophy: the illusion of speed
sections.markdown:
LLMs generate text very fast, but without rigorous guidance the output stays bland and generic. The core skill is the **Art of the Command**: moving from a "Google search" mindset to a complete **agency brief**.

AI has no inherent ideas or strategic vision—value stays in human intellect. Writing with AI is iterative dialogue (Cyborg/Centaur approach): the human supplies the core paragraph; AI helps with structure and format.

sections.title: Lessons: RACE and ROCOF frameworks
sections.markdown:
For professional copy, impose **Role, Objective/Action, Context, Constraints, Format**.

| Component | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| Role | Expert persona to narrow semantic field |
| Objective | Precise action, unambiguous verbs |
| Context | Audience, stakes, history |
| Constraints | Negative prompts, length, tone |
| Format | Operational output structure |

Example: "Act as a senior B2B copywriter; draft a 3-part LinkedIn thread on supply chain delays; audience: executives anxious about Q3 margins; no emojis; under 150 words per post; Markdown table with Hook / Body / CTA."

sections.title: Illustrations: the AI-ism epidemic
sections.markdown:
Spot and remove **AI tics**: "It's not just about…", overly optimistic closings, lexicon like *delve, intricate, tapestry, leverage, pivotal*.

Use `<bans>` and `<prefer>` tags to force an authentic semantic corridor. Human quality control remains mandatory before publication.

sections.title: Philosophy: the non-designer's eye
sections.markdown: Directing an image generator requires visual vocabulary: angles (close-up, Dutch angle, drone), lighting (volumetric, golden hour, Rembrandt), focal lengths, palettes. Without it, AI defaults to a generic plastic aesthetic.

sections.title: Lessons: DTP and Firefly integration
sections.markdown:
Integrate AI into professional **DTP** workflows (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign). Firefly supports Generative Expand, typography, and vectors in production environments.

**Adobe Firefly**: licensed training data, IP indemnification for enterprise.
**Midjourney**: superior creative flair but legal risk—internal mood boards only, not final public assets.

sections.title: Illustrations: EU AI Act transparency
sections.markdown:
By August 2026, Article 50 requires transparency on synthetic content: provenance metadata, robust watermarks, visible labels for deepfakes.

Penalties up to €7.5M or 1.5% global turnover. Marketing workflows must embed compliance at generation time.

sections.title: Philosophy: attention economics
sections.markdown: A 30–60s vertical video needs: **Hook** (first 3 seconds), paced **Body**, clear **CTA**. **Declination logic** adapts long-form content (article, whitepaper) into short scripts without losing the strategic core.

sections.title: Lessons: fragmented video stack
sections.markdown:
No single tool covers script, storyboard, voice, b-roll, and edit. Typical workflow:

1. **Script** (Claude/Gemini) with dialogue / visual direction columns
2. **Storyboard** (LTX Studio, Knowlify)
3. **TTS** (ElevenLabs) as timing anchor
4. **B-roll / avatars** (Runway, Kling, HeyGen, Synthesia)
5. **Assembly** (CapCut, Premiere, n8n)—captions, transitions, 9:16 / 16:9 ratios

sections.title: Illustrations: production pitfalls
sections.markdown: Common failures: character inconsistency across scenes, audio sync issues. Mitigations: reference images (Kling, Luma), or static avatars plus abstract product b-roll.
